original.statement: Traefik 3.0.0 adds support for SPIFFE mTLS between Traefik and backend servers.

decision.reason: [ev-e60b03c8ec6d] lists "Support SPIFFE mTLS between Traefik and Backend servers" under the v3.0.0 Enhancements, which describes new protocol capability on Traefik-to-backend connections. So an "added" change fits. The kebab-case name spiffe-mtls-backend uses only the evidence's own key words and is short without being ambiguous. The validators were inconclusive, which neither supports nor contradicts this.
